title: Incorrect inversion of automatic OPTIONS logic
detail: The code adds the OPTIONS method when provide_automatic_options is False, which is the opposite of the intended behavior. This can cause duplicate OPTIONS routes or missing OPTIONS handling.
note: Says the condition is inverted: OPTIONS is added when the setting is off.

title: Disabled plugins check crashes on None
detail: When PYDANTIC_DISABLE_PLUGINS is not set, disabled_plugins is None. The condition `disabled_plugins is None and entry_point.name in disabled_plugins.split(',')` attempts to call split() on None, raising AttributeError and preventing any plugins from loading.
note: Names the planted `is None` and the `None.split` it leads to.

title: Incorrect detached widget check
detail: The condition only returns when *both* widgets are detached. If one widget is detached, the code proceeds and later accesses it, causing an AttributeError or other failure. The intended behavior is to abort when *any* widget is detached.
note: Describes the planted `and`: it returns only when both widgets are detached.

title: Incorrect precedence in control‑code check
detail: The expression is parsed as `(codepoint and codepoint < 32) or (0x07F < codepoint < 0x0A0)`. For a codepoint like 0x200d (ZWJ), the first part is false and the second part is also false, so the function returns 1 instead of 0. This breaks the intended zero‑width handling for ZWJ and other control characters.
note: On the planted line, but about operator precedence and ZWJ, not the `<` that leaves DEL out; not checked further.
